sources.snippet: Key Contributions Proposed TTNet, a multi-task model integrating CNN, ResNet, and self-attention for sensor-based sports analysis; implemented a two-stage training strategy to handle imbalanced data; achieved second place in the AI CUP 2025 competition.

sources.title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with ...
sources.snippet: TTNet reads player attributes from smart-racket motion TTNet is a multitask model for six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets, built for the AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition. It predicts four player attributes at once: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level.
